about: Words video sites often block (they may still charge the credits). plan_tools.py prompts / check-prompts prints a warning (never an error) for each one found in a video or image prompt, with the group's hint; the style agents avoid them (style-agent-contract.md, Safe wording). Whole words, any case. Add a word or phrase to a group, or a new group with label, hint and words.

people.label: famous people and characters
people.hint: Describe a made-up person instead of a real or famous one: 'a woman in her 30s with short black hair', not a name.

children.label: children
children.hint: Use adults unless the brief needs a child; if it does, keep it everyday and fully clothed: 'a family at the breakfast table'.

body.label: body words
body.hint: Describe the action instead of the body: 'hand applies cream to the arm'.

medical.label: medical or cure claims
medical.hint: Show the product being used, without health promises: 'she smiles after her morning routine', not 'it cures acne'.

violence.label: violence, blood or weapons
violence.hint: Leave out blood, weapons and fights; describe a calm, safe action instead: 'she slices the mango on a board'.

brands.label: other brands
brands.hint: Show only the client's product; give everything else no brand: 'a plain white phone', 'unbranded sneakers'.
